_doc: Maxim Default-On Router (ADR-021). The UserPromptSubmit hook (user-prompt-router.{sh,ps1}) reads this to classify intent and inject a routing directive. Edit freely: add keywords, reorder, retune. Set enabled=false (or create .mxm-skills/router-off) to disable. A prompt matching no route passes through silently (vanilla Claude).
_weak_doc: Generic nouns that double as conversational words. A route firing on ONLY a single weak keyword (e.g. 'plan' in 'back to our plan', or 'design' in 'stack design' / 'system design') is NOT confident -> passthrough. Needs >=1 strong (non-weak) hit OR >=2 total hits. Add/remove freely. NOTE (BUG-012): 'design' is weak because it collides with architecture terms ('stack/system/API/routing design'); UI-design routing needs a co-signal (ui/ux/css/layout/figma/brand/banner/etc.).
_confidence_doc: BUG-012/PATTERN-04 hardening. Each route scores = (strong keyword hits) + (1 if a strong keyword appears in the first 160 chars — the operator's instruction zone, so incidental keywords deep in a pasted/quoted block score lower). A route fires ONLY if best_score >= confidence_floor AND it beats the runner-up by >= confidence_margin; otherwise the router passes through SILENTLY (no low-confidence banner). This replaced the old 'most raw hits, ties broken by array order' rule. Raise the floor to be more conservative; raise the margin to demand a clearer winner.

fallback._doc: When no route's keywords match well, suggest the v1.3.4 fallback skill search before treating it as a genuine gap.
fallback.note: External candidates are 🔴 Maxim-UNENHANCED (ADR-008) until the behavioral overlay is applied.
